statements.proposition: After this change, GroupActivitiesEndpoint supports cursor-based pagination via limit and cursor query parameters while the old behaviour (no cursor) still works.
statements.label: FALSE
statements.note: The new endpoint code does `from sentry.api.paginator import CursorPaginator`, but no class named CursorPaginator exists in sentry/api/paginator.py at the base or the head commit, and the PR changes only 3 files (the endpoint and two frontend files), so it does not add one. The import would raise ImportError when the module loads, so the endpoint cannot serve cursor requests and the no-cursor path (the 'backward compatibility' branch) fails with it. Read from source at base and head; code was not executed (Sentry's full environment not built). Secondary observations: `limit` is only applied on the no-cursor branch; on the cursor branch limit is not passed to the paginator.
